routes.text: Over six months the Narthani soldiers and settlers are shipped from the Preddi City wharf to Ezarkin, Narthon's westernmost port. The refuge on Klinwyn Island is never used. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Istranik's relief column
routes.text: General Istranik leaves Preddi City with 10,000 men and more than 200 wagons to resupply Gullar, picks up the Hanslow garrison and forces his way past burned bridges and felled trees toward Moreland City. He is stopped sixty miles short of Orosz City. The course between named points is drawn, not described.

routes.name: Fleet sails for Landolin
routes.text: A Fuomi sloop picketing north and east of Caedellium reports a Narthani fleet of warships and troop transports leaving Ezarkin and sailing south toward Landolin. It is too small for a full invasion, so the likely aim is a foothold in Naskin, the northernmost Landolin kingdom. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Mark's flight from Landylbury
routes.text: Hunted by Narthani-paid men, Mark Caldwell rides out of Landylbury, climbs the escarpment and crosses the Balgorn pass to his ranch 340 miles away, a pursuit party three miles behind. Twelve hours later he leaves with his wife Maghen, daughter Alys and six horses, making sure he is seen passing through Nurburt toward the Madyrna border. If followed, they plan to double back west to the sea and take ship north to Novaryn, set on eventually reaching Caedellium. The ranch and the course are approximate.

routes.name: Mark leaves Brawsea
routes.text: Mark Caldwell, an Earth castaway, spends his first year on Anyar around Brawsea, the Frangel capital, where he studies world maps in a library. After trouble with the guilds he flees south, away from the major cities, to the ranch country of central Frangel. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Mark's road to Nurburt
routes.text: Mark Caldwell leaves the ashes of Tregallon and rides east along the coast road, past Derwun Bay, to Brawsea. After killing Klinster he flees south: fifty miles to hide in rock outcrops, on to the village of Vynmor, two hundred miles more to the town of Ursalyn, then southwest to Nurburt, eleven hundred miles from the capital. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Mark's flight to the sea
routes.text: With the pursuers drawn toward Nurburt, the family turns south and then west on back roads, crossing north-south ridgelines and a broad plain to the fishing town of Munwurth on Frangel's west coast. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Across the Timbar Sea
routes.text: A Munwurth fishing boat carries the family six hundred miles across the Timbar Sea to Dawlber in southern Novaryn in eight days. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Mark crosses Tekleum
routes.text: Guided by Nunstel, the family rides eight days from Dawlber to Tekleum, then about five hundred miles across it, slipping past the Rumpas border post through the woods. A five-day barge trip down a Rumpasian river brings them to Heliom. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Voyage of the Dancer
routes.text: The caraculon Dancer carries Gulgit's muskets and Mark's family west from Heliom across the Throat, tacking against the wind for five sixdays before running down the Rustal coast to Orano. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Mark crosses Rustal
routes.text: The arms caravan rolls inland from Orano to the resistance camp in central Rustal. From there Gulgit's men ride with the family thirteen days west to the Gongalor Mountains, over the pass into Sulako, and three hundred miles on to Iskadon. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Voyage of the Wicked Woman
routes.text: The Buldorian ship Wicked Woman carries Mark, his family and Heather Chen a thousand sea miles along the Sulako coast to Bandapara, then southwest to Tortut. Refitted, she skirts the Ilskin coast, slips past a Narthani frigate, rounds the west of Landolin through the Great Ocean and turns north for Caedellium, where a Fuomi sloop takes them into Preddi City. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Heather sold to Iskadon
routes.text: Found naked on a beach, Heather Chen is held by the headman of a nearby fishing village, who sells her to the Iskadon slave trader Halari. She is taken about fifty miles to the city, where she will spend three years as his slave, singing Earth songs at his music hall. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Mark's train to Orosz City
routes.text: Mark Caldwell, his family and Heather Chen leave Preddi City by horse-drawn train, cross the unfinished gap southwest of Hanslow by carriage, and ride on through the night past Moreland City, arriving in Orosz City on the afternoon of the second day. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Mark's tour of the ironworks
routes.text: Mark Caldwell takes Yozef by train from Orosz City to the ironworks at Wungford in Pewitt and on, without stopping at Penmawr, to the steelworks at Elmor in Swavebroke. Between trips he also visits the ore mines of Bultecki and Vandinke, the steam group at Adris City and the Hilstrom Inlet works. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Koskanin's squadron
routes.text: A Fuomi squadron of two war-galleons, five frigates, sloops and supply ships carries the new ambassador Irvod Koskanin from Fuomon. It runs the Throat, hugs the Ganolar coast, fights Narthani ships off Sulako, rounds the west of Landolin and comes in through the Normot Gap to Adris City. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Crossing to Brudermyn
routes.text: A Fuomi sloop carries Yozef, Maera and two squads of Pewitt dragoons a hundred miles west from Penmawr across the Seaborn Strait. It enters Furwyn Sound, sails forty miles along the north coast of South Island, passes Brudermyn to clear the reefs and turns back south into the harbor. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Paramount's tour of South Island
routes.text: From Brudermyn the party drives past Nillor to the Yastern Valley terraces, crosses a ridge to Grastor, climbs a cleft to Stiltern Fall and rides through farm country to Nollagen. Fleeing the Kolinkan raid, it turns north through the chute at Pewitt's Glory and Milgorn Gorge back to Grastor. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Kolinkan raid on Seaborn
routes.text: On its third attempt, a Kolinkan squadron of about twenty coastal ships, carrying some 350 men and 400 horses, sails from Kolinka. It stays wide of the Fuomi patrols, waits southwest of Seaborn and closes on South Island to land at Brintyn Cove. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Kolinkan flight
routes.text: After loading its men at Nollagen for hours, the Kolinkan squadron sails north up the Seaborn Strait and away east-northeast toward Kolinka, abandoning about fifty raiders on the island. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Mark to Hilstrom
routes.text: Mark Caldwell goes from Orosz City to Hilstrom Inlet with sixty-two workers to start the steamship site, then returns to Orosz City nearly a sixday later. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Mark's train to Penmawr
routes.text: Mark rides the train from Orosz City to Penmawr with Yozef and Synton, then goes on by carriage to see Hetman Pewitt about the immigrant workers.

routes.name: Alliance fleet to Penabak
routes.text: After three days of loading at Sellmor, the Alliance Division sails south, collects ships at Preddi City and Adris City, then crosses the open sea east to Penabak. The fleet has 103 Fuomi ships plus Munjorian, Naskinese, Ponomynan and Caedelli vessels, and the last of them arrives four sixdays later. The course is approximate.

routes.name: March on Chikawan
routes.text: The Alliance main force marches northeast from Penabak through the border forest, brush and grassland into the badlands. It wins the battles at the edge of the badlands and at the Tahpulta Ravine, then advances in three columns across farmland to the Chikok River outside Chikawan. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Tasman's column
routes.text: Tasman Gangala's Ponomynan cavalry and infantry cross a gap cut by the Zamzul River, take the lower and middle Zamzul bridges, and then swing southeast around the badlands to join Kivalian's dragoons for the attack on the Tahpulta line. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Racer to Kahmo
routes.text: The courier ship Racer carries Paavo Saisannin and the recalled ambassador Koskanin home. It hugs Landolin's eastern shore, crosses the narrowest part of the Rudipar Sea to the Sonet coast, and follows the Iraquinik shore south before crossing the Throat to Kahmo, a voyage of about two months. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Torkinian's fleet
routes.text: Admiral Torkinian's fleet and later Fuomi convoys sail from Fuomon across the Great Ocean on seasonal winds, stopping at Eurako in the Murvor Islands. They approach Caedellium from the east-southeast and pass the Normot Gap into Adris City. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Robin's journeys
routes.text: Hizer takes Robin Kehlee and her son two sixdays by imperial road from Esrohir to Kustal. Later he brings them to Akuyun's headquarters at Tormkee and on to the Ergoman estate. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Robin's return to Kustal
routes.text: Ordered back to Kustal, Robin's party travels by carriage to the port of Ordum, takes an assessor courier sloop across the Gulf of Numara to Balaseer, and finishes overland to Kustal in three or four days. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Mission to Munjor
routes.text: Swavebroke's training battalion, scholars and Vernik's staff sail from Adris City on a Fuomi troop ship to Bawfa, Munjor's main port at the northern entrance of the Amalor Strait. They spread out from Samlor across Munjor and return the same way months later. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Amalor supply line
routes.text: Narthani supplies land at Purdom, cross the narrow width of Amalor by road to the small port of Ruvati and go by coastal trader over the reef-strewn Amalor Strait to Balabad in Jahmnor. The allies decide to land in northern Amalor and cut it. The book's prose names the two ports the other way round; this follows the author's invasion map. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Yozef's voyage home
routes.text: Yozef's Fuomi frigate leaves Penabak at dusk for Kweslon, then takes two sixdays against a southerly storm to sight a towering peak and run southeast along the coast to Silata. From there it returns to Caedellium through the Normot Gap to Adris City. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Enterprise to Naskin
routes.text: The Enterprise steams about twelve hundred miles from Hilstrom to Silata in four days past a line of picket ships, and back again with King Gompta, rounding the southern tip of Gwillamer and running up past Preddi and Selfcell to Hilstrom Inlet. The course is approximate.

routes.name: Mark's trains to Hilstrom
routes.text: Mark Caldwell spends the book shuttling between Orosz City and the Hilstrom shipyard, once by special night train by way of Cherona and Clitwyth. He fits out the Enterprise at Hilstrom, repairs her seized screw when she returns from Naskin, and later comes back to Orosz City to run the allied war games.

routes.name: Mark at Wungford
routes.text: Mark takes the train from Hilstrom with King Gompta and Yozef to tour the Wungford ironworks, where his overhead-paddle puddling furnaces, steam hammers and rollers make armor plate for the Enterprise class. The course is approximate.
